instruction.name: vpackev.h
instruction.description: Interleave even-positioned 16-bit elements of `a` and `b`: the element from `b` is placed at the even output position and the element from `a` at the following odd position.

notes: LSX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
